review.notes: Full review. Previous R01-R07, R09, R11 repaired; R08 partly (R07 here); R10 repaired but its suggested docstring bullet misdescribes Mathlib (R01 here). Findings: P2 4.1 Hochschild-dimension characterisation statable at the pins via TensorProduct.Algebra.module and absent (elaborated in scratch); P2 4.2 separable implies quasi-free false over a commutative ring (Z/2 over Z); P2 1.4 needs V flat since the suppliers' HC resolves non-flat algebras; P3 two false Checks (4.6 Check 2, 3.1 Check 2); P3 1.2 ground ring; P3 unowned Morita invariance of HH/HC in Layer 5 Examples; P3 work-only locators; P3 5.4 field hypothesis; P3 process references. Gate rerun OK (all counters 0), depcheck 0 problems, Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry the only warning, 16 one-tactic probes close nothing, 6 signatures compared. Sampled sources read: Loday-Quillen pp. 581-587 (GDZ page images), Kassel-Loday (Numdam), Cuntz-Quillen 1995a/b (AMS), Cortinas (arXiv), Dwyer-Hopkins-Kan (AMS), Connes' book, zbMATH reviews for Quillen 1996, Marin 1998, Gonzalez-Ferez-Marin 2007, Goodwillie 1985. Not read: Goodwillie, Wodzicki, Suslin-Wodzicki, Cuntz-Quillen 1993/1997, Quillen 1996, Marin, Gonzalez-Ferez-Marin texts (paywalled).
